text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor b-r-o-w-s-e-d the m-u-n-i-c-i-p-a-l i-t-y s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e-s to f-i-n-d a-v-a-i-l-a-b-l-e a-c-c-e-s-s c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a q-u-e-r-y l-o-g a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the actor e-n-r-o-l-l-e-d a f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y i-n-t-o the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c s-c-a-n-n-e-r u-s-i-n-g s-y-n-t-h-e-t-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g a r-e-g-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
3) the actor b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d the r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d z-o-n-e b-a-r-r-i-e-r-s v-i-a u-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d e-n-t-r-y p-o-i-n-t-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a m-o-t-i-o-n-s-e-n-s-o-r t-r-a-c-k a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-a-t-e-w-a-y p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor a-l-t-e-r-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g e-n-t-r-y-t-i-m-e-s a-n-d u-s-e-r i-d-s to m-i-m-i-c a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d l-o-g f-i-l-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-t-a-m-p v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the actor c-l-e-a-r-e-d the r-e-m-o-t-e s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s a-f-t-e-r the i-n-s-i-d-e o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n w-a-s c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d, e-l-i-m-i-n-a-t-i-n-g a n-e-t-w-o-r-k a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-v-e-r-y a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
